description: This Java class, GroupOwnerSocketHandler, manages server socket connections for WiFi Direct group owners in an Android application. It listens on port 4545, accepts incoming socket connections, and delegates handling to ChatManager instances via a thread pool.

classes.name: GroupOwnerSocketHandler
classes.description: Handles server socket connections for WiFi Direct group owners, accepting incoming connections and delegating to ChatManager.

methods.name: GroupOwnerSocketHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the server socket on port 4545 and sets the handler.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Continuously listens for incoming socket connections, spawning a ChatManager for each, until an IOException occurs.
